messages:
Hannah B: quick convo 1: Datadog + OpenTelemetry guidance for the cloud marketplace HW tile. need final artifacts by EOD Wed.
Marcelo D: list the artifacts so we don't miss anything.
Hannah B: OTEL sample config, dashboard JSON, trace-to-metric mapping doc, small ops runbook (rotation/retention), and a 3min demo recording.
Anita S: partner insists on these span attrs: model_id, seq_len, and quant_setting. seq_len is fine, but quant_setting could be high-card. proposal: only emit quant_setting when not "fp16" or "default".
Yusuf A: agree on conditional emission. also recommend adding model_family as a coarse attr to avoid exploding model_id cardinality in some customers.
Marcelo D: sampling policy? partner asked for low baseline sampling but full sampling for errors & tail latency. OTEL tail_sampling should cover it.
Anita S: here's a minimal OTEL snippet we can share:
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  tail_sampling:
    policies:
      - name: error_policy
        type: string_attribute
        string_attribute:
          key: "error"
          values: ["true"]
      - name: tail_latency
        type: latency
        latency:
          threshold_ms: 500
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}
```
Yusuf A: add a note: index dd.trace_id in logs for linking and index model_family but avoid indexing quant_setting to control costs.
Hannah B: dashboard naming convention for marketplace tile? product asked for predictable paths.
Marcelo D: suggest `Marketplace / Observability / <PartnerName> / Model / <model_family> / Latency`. keeps it vendor-neutral.
Anita S: i'll draft the dashboard JSON with tiles: p50, p95, error_rate, and qps. will include an example Datadog query for linking traces: `avg:trace.inference.latency{model_family:resnet}.rollup(p50)`
Yusuf A: ops runbook should call out disk pressure on collectors and include `logrotate` sample and retention: 7d for traces, 30d for metrics. also mention fallback to metrics-only when high-card spans degrade UI.
Marcelo D: we should include a tiny synthetic load demo to validate dashboards. i can prep a containerized load gen and drop link.
Hannah B: please add the repo link in the PR. also schedule a dry-run with partner Tue 10am PT.

Hannah B: i'll open the marketplace PR after the dry run with owners for each artifact. tagging legal for announcement text afterward. thanks all :rocket:
Marcelo D: posting demo repo: https://git.internal/redwood/marketplace-telemetry-demo (check /bin/generate_load).
Anita S: will upload dashboard JSON to the PR draft tonight.
Yusuf A: i'll write the trace-to-metric mapping doc and include examples of recommended metric names and tags.
Hannah B: perfect — deadline EOD Wed. if anything blocks, flag here.
